title: Is Stem Classroom the Appropriate Learning Environment Where Students Can Achieve Their Learning Objectives?
content: In any educational process, the learning environment plays an important role before the choice of educational method. On the other hand, STEM education is the one that has emerged in recent years as a promising modern pedagogical approach. In this article, we will first discuss the basic characteristics that a learning environment should have in order to facilitate students to master the learning objectives set at any given time. Then, the characteristics of a STEM classroom are referred to in order to investigate whether the latter finally has the necessary characteristics to contribute to the mastery of the learning objectives.
